intersections.scope: Indexed polygon bounds and triangle contact vertices, both quad diagonals with every mixed triangle pairing, 1e-9 length tolerance. Contacts are allowed only on common topological vertices/edges (4e-9 boundary tolerance). Floating-point screen; degeneracy and manifold checks are separate.

surface.scope: Both quad diagonals require adaptive whole-triangle distance bounds in both directions; budgets reject unresolved bounds. Double-precision checks, separate from intersections.

sourceToOutput.reason: A surface point exceeds the distance tolerance

02.scope: Adaptive triangle subdivision with convex point-to-triangle upper bounds in both directions. Double precision with a roundoff margin; unresolved depth/work budgets reject. Does not check topology or intersections.
